newsitem.title: USA: GM to idle 3 plants next week.
newsitem.headline: GM to idle 3 plants next week.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Thursday it will idle one car plant and two light truck plants the week of April 21.
GM said its Ste. Therese car plant in Quebec that makes the Chevrolet Camero and Pontiac Firebird will not operate next week.
The automaker said its Fairfax, Kansas, plant that makes the Pontiac Grand Prix and its Detroit Hamtramck facility that produces Cadillacs will operate Saturday overtime.
On the truck side, GM will idle its compact pickup truck plant in Shreveport, La., next week. As previously disclosed, GM will also shut down its Wentzville, Mo., full-size van plant.
GM scheduled overtime at its Janesville, Wis., sport/utility plant; and full-size pickup truck plants in Fort Wayne, Ind., and Oshawa, Ontario.
